{{Top}}
An '''entropy field''' was a fourth-order [[Electromagnetic field/Legends|electromagnetic field]] that allowed its user to suspend an object in [[Time/Legends|time]]. A [[stasis booth]] produced an entropy field to suspend living organisms.
